crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Roughly elliptical white patch containing two symmetrical dark spots on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Abrupt linear transition from white nape patch to grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Vivid horizontal black and white barring on the tail; presence of red pigmentation near the bill base.
